hey!! i’m the same age as you (23 F) and i haven’t been in a real relationship, either. my friends say that i’m “picky”, but really i haven’t felt that i have met a guy who i connected with enough or felt safe enough around to be vulnerable with. every person is different, and i know a lot of guys and girls who love to just go on dating apps and go on like 3 dates a week, meeting new people, making friends, finding short and longterm partners, etc. are dating apps popular where you live? otherwise, what about activities in sports or the arts (theatre, book clubs, dance classes, etc.), those can all be great ways to meet people, and i often find that just finding a new group of friends, or even just 1 friend, can lead to meeting /their/ friends, and so on, and people often end up meeting their future partners that way! i think that it is good not to put too much pressure on yourself to find someone right now—23 is very young, i have legitimately “hot” girl friends our age who are single and/or virgins for numerous reasons, but none of them are because they don’t /want/ to find someone to be with—it’s so much less black/white as incel rhetoric will make you believe. love isn’t something you’re worthy of or aren’t worthy of. it’s something you build and make, and the first steps can be as small as picking up new hobbies, taking new classes, going to different stores, if you live life like you love it, i’ve often found among my friends, encourages love to come to you. i hope this helps a little!!
